Bonacare Mechanical leak-inspection invoice -> commercial, happy path. THE no-fault-found anchor: the technician attended, ran the heating system, found NO leak, and concluded the roof was the cause rather than the plumbing. diagnosis_solution must report that ('a finding of no fault is still a finding' -- the prompt's step 4); a summary that returns '' because nothing was repaired is the failure this document guards. It is also the negative anchor for the other two narrative fields: this invoice proposes no further work and mentions no warranty, so recommendation, recommendation_zh_hant and warranty are all asserted '' -- if a generate field starts inventing content where there is none, it shows up here first. invoice_date 2025-10-21 comes from the printed 21/10/2025 (unambiguous: 21 cannot be a month). service_address is read from the Service Address block (4338 Pandora St, Burnaby), NOT the Bill To block, which is Noble's own Maycrest Way office. || NOT asserted here: payment_due_date -- the invoice prints payment terms ('15 Days') but no due date, so the write value is the today+30 default and would change with the run date; diagnosis_solution and diagnosis_solution_zh_hant (free text, reworded on every replicate -- verified correct by eye across 3 runs: all report the heating system being run, no leak found, and the roof identified as the cause); invoice_description (free text, excluded by standing rule). || service_address is NOT asserted: the same correct address comes back with the city on a new line or on the same line ('4338 Pandora St Burnaby , BC' vs '4338 Pandora St
Burnaby , BC') across replicates. Line-breaking variance only -- not assertable under exact string comparison. Removed after a --force re-roll exposed it; the original 3-replicate scaffold happened to agree.
